decisions.reason: Although it has less public visibility than other launches, the multi-model line represents sunk investment that management will tend to justify by keeping it.
Its dedicated page over two years signals visible commitment and accumulated investment, making persistence likely.
The product has a dedicated page and established presence, creating sunk costs and public commitment that favor keeping it.
Showcased on the home page and built as a multi-model line, it is a highly visible, central commitment, so dropping is very unlikely.
Its dedicated page indicates public commitment and investment, which under escalation logic argues for keeping it.
The trade-fair award and public mention support persistence, and the positive result gives management additional reason to keep it.
